entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi... I think I need to make a return? I'm just so lost with the website and all the policies. I'm not sure what I'm doing.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. I can definitely help clear things up for you. Could I start with your name and order number, please?
Oh, sure. My name is Sarah Jenkins. The order number is... uh, hold on... VF88602. It's for that new helmet.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now. Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic helmet. I can certainly help you with this. Just so I can document it correctly, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

Oh, preference, I guess? The online picture showed a different shade, and the color just isn't what I expected. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out. I'm just so overwhelmed with this. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah. I can absolutely help. It's completely understandable that the color wasn't a perfect match. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 10 days ago.
That's great news. You are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I have gone ahead and approved this return for you for a full refund. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's it? It's that simple?

It is. And since you're a VIP member, I want to make it even easier. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email right now. You just have to print it and put it on the box. I've also added a $15 credit to your account for the trouble. We want to make sure you have gear you love, especially when it comes to your safety.
Wow. A credit, too? Alex, you've been so helpful. I was so stressed about this. Thank you so much!
You are very welcome, Sarah. It's my pleasure to assist. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything! Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
